name: OBS Recording (OCR text targeting)
description: Design doc section 9's canonical worked example, verbatim: FindText locates 'Start Recording' by reading the screen (PaddleOCR/Tesseract, Phase 4) and positions the mouse there, then a bare Click (no coordinates) clicks wherever FindText just found. Unlike the Phase 1 coordinate-based sample, this keeps working if OBS's window moves or is resized.
